items.program: SM/ME Computational Science and Engineering (related master's; no standalone CS MS)

gre.detail: SEAS CSE how-to-apply (updated 2026-09-04) and GSAS Engineering program page: General GRE and Subject GRE scores are optional for the upcoming cycle. No single factor used as a filter.

gmat.detail: Pure SEAS CSE/Data Science master's do not use GMAT. SEAS FAQ notes GRE or GMAT is required only for Master of Design Engineering / MS-MBA Engineering Sciences (separate GSD/HBS applications)—not for CSE SM/ME.

toefl.detail: GSAS English proficiency (Fall 2027): non-native speakers without an undergraduate degree from an English-primary-instruction institution must submit TOEFL iBT. Minimum overall 5 (95 for tests taken prior to 2026-01-21) and Speaking 4.5 (23 prior to 2026-01-21). ETS code 3451; dept 99. Duolingo not accepted. Master's degree alone not accepted as proof.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic minimum overall 7 and Speaking 6.5 (GSAS). Send via IELTS E-Delivery to Harvard Griffin GSAS. Home/online Academic versions accepted.

english.waiver: Undergraduate degree from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction. US institutions where English was not primary but a significant portion was in English may petition GSAS (US institutions only). SEAS FAQ: no waivers for the English Language Proficiency Requirement beyond GSAS pathways. Scores for Fall 2027 must be from tests taken no earlier than 2025-01-05.

gpa.detail: SEAS CSE how-to-apply: no GPA cutoff / no minimum GPA requirement. Holistic review.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters required from faculty, advisors, and/or employment supervisors who can speak to graduate-study ability; no more than four. Register recommenders in GSAS application; Interfolio not accepted. Late letters may be added but review begins after Dec 1.

statementOfPurpose.detail: About 1,000 words covering experiences (including training not on transcript), interests, and future goals.

resume.detail: CV/resume covering education, work experience, honors, awards, papers, and other achievements.

transcripts.detail: Upload electronic official or unofficial transcripts; do not mail hard copies. Fall grades can be updated after submission via Fall Grade Report.

interview.detail: SEAS CSE how-to-apply: interview not required and in-person interviews with admissions staff are not offered.

applicationFee.waivers: Fee-waiver eligibility determined by answering questions in the Application Fee section of the GSAS application; immediate system response.
applicationFee.detail: Harvard Griffin GSAS application fee $105 payable by credit card (non-refundable).

other: FLAG: Harvard CS PhD page confirms no standalone CS master's; related terminal master's are Computational Science and Engineering (SM/ME) and Data Science—do not treat as MS CS.
Fall Term matriculation only; CSE/Data Science portal open for Fall 2027; GSAS deadline December 1, 2026.
Select Engineering and Applied Sciences → Computational Science and Engineering → SM or ME.
Do not apply to both Data Science and CSE.
No formal prerequisites; successful applicants show calculus, linear algebra, DEs, probability/stats, programming (e.g. Python/R), and basic CS concepts.
Master's candidates not eligible for SEAS financial aid.
applicationRequirements.advice: Related CSE SM/ME for Fall 2027 (as_of 2026-10-27). Prefer how-to-apply + GSAS English/fee pages over CS PhD curriculum page. TOEFL uses new 0–6 scale minima for tests on/after 2026-01-21.
sources: SEAS CS graduate program (PhD; points to related master's)
Harvard Griffin GSAS Applying to Degree Programs (fee)

items.program: MS in Computer Science / Master of Computer Science (MCS)

gre.detail: Siebel School does not require GRE for any graduate programs. Scores recommended but not required; applicants may scan official score report PDF to application (official ETS report not required). MCS overview: no GRE required for admission.

gmat.detail: Not part of Siebel CS/MCS admissions; GRE is the only standardized test discussed.

toefl.detail: Illinois Graduate College English proficiency for admission (unless exempt). Full-status TOEFL iBT minimum 5.0 for scores dated after 2026-01-20 (103 prior to 2026-01-21); limited-status 4.0 (79 prior). Institution code 1836. Siebel also notes funding/TA speak minima separately.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic full-status minimum 7.5; limited-status 6.5 (Graduate College). Send electronically to University of Illinois Urbana Champaign Graduate.

english.waiver: Exempt if post-secondary degree from U.S. or approved English-primary country within five years of proposed term; or ≥2 years post-secondary study or professional work in U.S./approved country within five years. Medium of instruction alone (if country not on exempt list) does not waive. Duolingo accepted for admission (115 limited / 135 full) but not for TA speak requirement.

gpa.detail: Campus Graduate College: at least 3.0/4.0 in last two years of undergraduate study required for eligibility. MCS app-info recommends undergraduate GPA 3.2/4.0 or higher (recommended, not a hard MCS-only floor beyond campus rule).

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: MCS (Urbana/Chicago/Online): letters not required; will be considered if included (especially to justify experience in lieu of coursework). Research MS with thesis / PhD / MS Bioinformatics / BS-MS: three letters required. Checklist marks MCS LOR as None.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Academic Statement of Purpose required (generally 1–2 pages: goals, background, work history, interests). Personal Statement also required for CS admissions (≤250 words).
statementOfPurpose.alsoKnownAs: Academic Statement of Purpose; Personal Statement

resume.detail: CV/resume required as part of online application (education, jobs, research for MS/PhD, achievements, publications, awards, leadership).

transcripts.detail: Upload scanned unofficial transcripts (with grading scale) for each post-secondary institution; official credentials only if recommended for admission / after admit.

interview.detail: No interview requirement stated on MCS overview, MCS app-info, or Applications Process & Requirements pages reviewed.

applicationFee.waivers: May qualify per Graduate College Application Fee Waivers; contact grad-admissions@siebelschool.illinois.edu with questions.
applicationFee.detail: Effective Spring 2026 cycle: $90 for all applicants (domestic and international), non-refundable, credit card with web application.

other: Tracks: coursework MCS (campus Urbana, Chicago, Online) vs research MS with thesis—application materials differ (esp. LORs).
MCS prereqs for non-CS bachelor's: OOP, data structures, algorithms, linear algebra, statistics/probability (or commensurate experience).
Applicants already holding an equivalent CS/CE master's are not eligible for MS or MCS.
Urbana/Chicago MCS Fall deadline May 1; Spring Oct 15 (CS MS Fall Dec 1)—confirm cycle on deadlines page.
Personal Statement (≤250 words) is additional required essay beyond Academic SOP.
applicationRequirements.advice: Given URL is professional MCS; research MS has stricter LOR (3). Report both under illinois-cs; site should distinguish MCS vs MS thesis checklists.

gre.detail: MSE CS admissions: GRE not required; listed as optional material. FAQ also states GRE scores are not reviewed by CS / not included in admissions review—optional≠waived; submitting may have no effect.

gmat.detail: Not used for Whiting MSE CS; only GRE discussed as optional/not reviewed.

toefl.detail: International / non-native English speakers: TOEFL ≥100 (ITP Level 1 and iBT Home Edition accepted). Institution code C559. Scores older than 2 years not accepted.

ielts.detail: IELTS ≥7.0. Send to Johns Hopkins University, Whiting School of Engineering. Duolingo English Test ≥135 also listed.

english.waiver: See Whiting English proficiency waiver eligibility page linked from MSE FAQ. All non-native English speakers must take TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo per FAQ.

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA stated on MSE CS admissions page; holistic review. Background equivalent to BS CS expected.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Two letters required via online application; only two guaranteed to be read regardless of how many submitted.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Required; upload via online application (file ≤500KB, ~1–2 pages, 1-inch margins per FAQ).

transcripts.detail: Upload transcript copies for review; official transcript requested upon admission.

interview.detail: Interview not listed among required MSE CS application materials on admissions or FAQ pages reviewed.

applicationFee.waivers: Whiting School $75 fee waived for Fall 2027 master's applicants; admissions page: Apply free / no application fees required.
applicationFee.detail: Applications free for Fall 2027 MSE CS (fee waived).

other: Fall 2027 deadline Feb 15 (11:59 p.m. EST); Spring 2027 Oct 1.
Sample of work optional.
Non-CS backgrounds need intermediate programming (C++ and Java), data structures, computer-system fundamentals, and mathematical foundations (coursework/research/work).
HLT concentration and AI track available; distinct from Engineering for Professionals evening/online MS.
applicationRequirements.advice: Prefer MSE Admissions + FAQ over program-requirements/curriculum pages. GRE optional≠waived; FAQ says scores not reviewed.

gre.detail: CS Applying for Admission: GRE scores are not required. Holistic review.

gmat.detail: Not part of UMD CS graduate application materials.

toefl.detail: Applicants whose native language is not English must submit official TOEFL or IELTS from the testing agency (self-reported not accepted). Grad School full-enrollment TOEFL iBT: Total 96 with section minima Reading 26 / Listening 24 / Speaking 22 / Writing 24 for tests on/before 2026-01-20; Overall 5 with section minima Reading/Listening/Writing 5 and Speaking 4.5 for tests on/after 2026-01-21. Code 5814.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic full enrollment: Overall 7; Reading/Listening/Writing 7; Speaking 6.5 (Graduate School). Electronic scores to UMD Graduate School e-download account.

english.waiver: Exempt if degree from regionally accredited U.S. institution or recognized institution in Grad School English-speaking countries list (must have studied in-country, not online/branch campus). CS apply page points to Grad School admissions for details.

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA stated on CS apply page; holistic review. Competitive applicants typically show strong academic record / bachelor's in CS or closely related field.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters from individuals qualified to assess academic or research potential. Letter writers have two weeks past Dec 4, 2026 deadline to submit.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Personal statement describing academic background, research interests, and goals.

resume.detail: Current CV detailing academic and professional experience.

transcripts.detail: Official transcripts from all colleges attended; upload unofficial initially; official upon admission. Abroad: unofficial translations with application; certified official upon admission.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CS Applying for Admission checklist.

applicationFee.waivers: Department does not offer fee waivers; may be available through UMD Graduate School for eligible applicants.

other: Program code CSMS (M.S.) vs CMSC (Ph.D.). Portal opens Jul 1, 2026; closes Dec 4, 2026; Fall entry only.
Given URL ms-policy-manual is degree/policy for enrolled MS students—not admissions checklist; admissions facts taken from /grad/apply.
Local note flagged PhD-en-route MS in catalog; CSMS remains listed as MS application code on admissions page—confirm route with department.
Recommended prereq coursework includes algorithms, data structures, advanced CS (e.g. CMSC 330/420/451) and calculus/linear algebra.
applicationRequirements.advice: Use /grad/apply for applicationRequirements; treat ms-policy-manual as degree rules only.
sources: UMD CS M.S. Degree Requirements (policy manual)
UMD Graduate School English Language Proficiency

items.program: MS / MSE in Computer Science and Engineering

gre.detail: CSE How to Apply / FAQs: GRE scores are neither required nor considered / not expected; committee will not consider any submitted scores.

gmat.detail: Not used for CSE Rackham MS/MSE admissions.

toefl.detail: Non-native English speakers must demonstrate proficiency unless Rackham exemption met. Michigan Engineering Academic Services minima (College page CSE applicants are directed to follow): TOEFL iBT overall 84 before 2026-01-21 and 4.5 on/after 2026-01-21; ETS code 1839. CSE apply page points to Rackham exemptions.

ielts.detail: Academic IELTS minimum overall 6.5 (Michigan Engineering Academic Services English proficiency table). Official electronic scores to University of Michigan–Ann Arbor.

english.waiver: Rackham exemptions include: native English speaker; Puerto Rico applicant; completed all undergraduate education and earned undergraduate degree at English-only instruction institution; completed all graduate education and earned graduate degree at English-only instruction institution; current U-M student. One-year research-only master's typically does not qualify.

gpa.detail: CSE Graduate Admissions: successful applicants usually have undergraduate GPA of at least 3.5/4.0 (not a hard requirement).

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters via Rackham online recommendation system only (no email/mail/Interfolio). Suggested ≥2 from academia.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Academic Statement of Purpose (≤3 pages) on academic/research background, career goals, and fit with CSE. Separate Personal Statement (≤500 words) also required—not identical to SOP.

resume.detail: Resume highlighting education, work, research publications, teaching, professional activities, volunteer service, honors/awards.

transcripts.detail: Upload electronic official transcripts for each bachelor’s/master’s/professional/doctoral degree earned or in progress; official to Rackham if recommended/admitted. Non-U.S.: follow Rackham country credentials guidance.

interview.detail: Interview not listed on CSE How to Apply checklist or admissions FAQs reviewed.

applicationFee.waivers: Rackham fee waivers for U.S. citizens/permanent residents with demonstrated financial need (Pell and/or SAI <$1,500); request before submission. Individual programs may also offer waivers.
applicationFee.detail: Rackham: $75 U.S. citizens/permanent residents; $90 non-U.S. citizens; $10 current Rackham students. amountUsd records international rate commonly used for intl CS applicants.

other: Master's (MS/MSE) deadline January 15 (Fall only); PhD Dec 15; SUGS separate.
MS vs MSE: same requirements; MSE only if bachelor's in engineering.
Admission to Master's typically without departmental financial aid.
Cannot hold same CS MS/PhD already earned elsewhere and re-apply for same degree at Michigan.
applicationRequirements.advice: GRE is not_accepted (not considered), not merely optional. Include both SOP and Personal Statement.
sources: Michigan Engineering Prepare Application Materials (English minima)

items.program: EECS graduate (PhD route; no external terminal MS)

gre.detail: EECS Graduate Admissions Information Letter and OGE program page: department does NOT require GRE scores for admission.

gmat.detail: Not used for EECS PhD admissions.

toefl.detail: International students: TOEFL iBT minimum 100; institute code 3514; department code 78 or 66. OGE: IELTS preferred over TOEFL; waiver may be available.

ielts.detail: IELTS minimum 7; electronic scores to MIT Graduate Admissions. EECS letter: IELTS can be used if TOEFL unavailable; same waiver cases as TOEFL.

english.waiver: EECS letter: TOEFL/IELTS may be waived e.g. if applicant has been in the U.S. at least two years, or if country's first language is English. OGE notes waiver of TOEFL/IELTS may be available.

gpa.detail: EECS letter: admission influenced by GPA but there is not an official cut-off.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Three letters of recommendation required (EECS letter and OGE application requirements).

statementOfPurpose.detail: OGE: Essay 1 research activities and goals; Essay 2 academic and intellectual journey. EECS letter refers to Statement of Objectives detailing research interests.

resume.detail: Resume/CV not explicitly listed on OGE EECS application-requirements block reviewed (online application, two essays, three LORs, transcripts, English scores).

transcripts.detail: Transcripts required; admitted students submit official transcript(s) to EECS Graduate Office. Do not send published papers or theses with application.

interview.detail: Interview not stated on OGE EECS program page or EECS admissions information letter reviewed.

applicationFee.waivers: Applicants can request a fee waiver via OGE eligibility criteria / EECS fee-waiver link.

other: FLAG — NO EXTERNAL TERMINAL MASTER'S: Department does not offer admission for a terminal master's. Apply for PhD; SM earned en route if needed. MEng degrees restricted to MIT undergraduates only.
Application opens Sep 15; deadline Dec 1 11:59 p.m. Eastern; Fall Term (September); Summer only for LGO.
Extremely competitive; strong background in math, physics, engineering, or CS expected.
PhD students typically supported by fellowship/RA/TA (tuition, stipend, medical insurance).
applicationRequirements.advice: Flag as PhD-only / no external MS for Fall 2027 slate. Requirements above are for the EECS PhD application path only.
sources: MIT EECS Graduate Admissions Information Letter

gre.detail: CS Admissions: GRE scores are neither required nor reviewed for the 2026–2027 masters program application (GRE required for PhD). FAQ: GRE not required for master's.

gmat.detail: Not used for Northwestern CS MS (TGS); GRE is the only optional/required standardized exam discussed by department.

toefl.detail: TGS: all applicants must prove English proficiency via TOEFL iBT / IELTS Academic / MET unless waiver approved. Master's TOEFL iBT minimum 80 for exams before 2026-01-21; all applicants minimum 4.5 after 2026-01-21. School code 1565. CS FAQ notes median TOEFL among offers was 108 (descriptive, not a published floor).

ielts.detail: TGS minimum IELTS Academic score = 7. At-home Indicator accepted when organization Northwestern University - The Graduate School is selected.

english.waiver: Waiver may be requested if undergraduate or graduate degree from institution that instructs primarily in English; request after application submission; approval at program/TGS discretion. DuoLingo and TOEFL Essentials not accepted by TGS.

gpa.detail: No published minimum beyond TGS. FAQ: average GPA for offers ~3.82 (descriptive). Leave GPA in home-institution scale; department converts.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: CS Admissions Tips: minimum of two letters required; three highly recommended. TGS application requirements list two letters.

statementOfPurpose.detail: Academic Statement required (TGS description); Personal Statement also per TGS. CS tips emphasize clear focus on specialization and faculty interest.

resume.detail: Resume/CV required among supplemental materials and McCormick/TGS checklists.

transcripts.detail: Upload scanned unofficial transcripts/PDFs with application; official may be required upon admission. Do not mail hard copies unless asked.

interview.detail: CS Admissions: primarily for PhD applicants, faculty may conduct interviews; not described as part of MS review.

applicationFee.waivers: CS FAQ: application fee waivers are not available for master's applicants. TGS waivers mainly for eligible PhD/MFA domestic applicants.
applicationFee.detail: TGS application fee $95 non-refundable (credit/debit with card logo).

other: Fall quarter only; terminal MS option distinct from PhD (select MS only if seeking terminal master's).
Fall 2027 entry applications opened Sep 15, 2026; rolling decision windows (e.g. submit by Nov 30 → decision by Jan 10; portal may close early when cohort full).
No financial aid for terminal MS.
Competitive background: CS degree or equivalent of at least a minor (multiple languages, data structures, discrete math).
applicationRequirements.advice: MS GRE is not_accepted (not reviewed), unlike PhD where GRE is required for 2026–2027.

gre.detail: GSAS Computer Science program page: GRE Optional for M.S. in Computer Science—applicants are not expected or required to submit GRE; may submit (official scores not needed at application time). Courant MS admissions FAQ: GRE recommended but not required.

gmat.detail: Courant MS admissions FAQ: GMAT and LSAT are not accepted as substitutes for the GRE.

toefl.detail: GSAS: official TOEFL, IELTS, or Duolingo required unless exempt. Courant FAQ guidance: TOEFL above 100 iBT (also cites historical paper 620 / computer 260). Institution code 2596; use TOEFL department code 99 (not 00).

ielts.detail: Courant FAQ: IELTS minimum band score 7.0. Send electronically to New York University, Graduate School of Arts and Science.

english.waiver: Exempt if native English speaker; OR U.S. citizen/permanent resident; OR completed (or will complete) a baccalaureate or master's degree at an institution where the language of instruction is English (GSAS Computer Science page).

gpa.detail: No numeric minimum GPA published on GSAS CS or Courant MS admissions FAQ; FAQ cites strong academic performance in relevant coursework.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: GSAS requires three letters of recommendation for degree applications; Courant FAQ expects positive specific letters. Submit via GSAS online system (no Interfolio).

statementOfPurpose.detail: GSAS CS: Statement of Academic Purpose—past/present work, educational objectives, career goals, reasons for field and NYU GSAS; should not exceed two double-spaced pages.

resume.detail: GSAS Application Resource Center: résumé or curriculum vitae is a required component of a complete application.

transcripts.detail: Academic transcripts required per GSAS ARC complete-application list.

interview.detail: Interview not listed for MSCS on GSAS Computer Science program page (video statement noted as optional/highly recommended for Information Systems MS only).

applicationFee.waivers: See GSAS application-fee / aid policies on ARC; not detailed as CS-specific on program page.
applicationFee.detail: GSAS application fee for most programs is $115 (Data Science $130; Math in Finance $150—not MSCS).

other: Fall admission deadline Feb 12; Spring Nov 1 (GSAS CS page; 5 p.m. Eastern).
Given URL current_mscsreq.html is degree/curriculum requirements (30/36-credit options, foundations)—not admissions checklist; admissions from GSAS ARC + Courant MS admissions FAQ.
MSCS technical prereqs (FAQ): deep C; OOP (Java/C++); data structures; math (induction, asymptotics, probability, combinatorics, sets); Windows/Unix familiarity.
Do not conflate with Tandon CS programs.
applicationRequirements.advice: Prefer GSAS Computer Science ARC + Courant MS admissions FAQ over the curriculum requirements URL for applicationRequirements.
sources: NYU GSAS Computer Science program requirements & deadlines
Courant MSCS degree requirements (curriculum; not admissions)
